action_items: Investigate pre-existing worker 'integer division or modulo by zero' on ~18 live drafts (see backend logs) — likely unrelated to iter231ad but visible in shared preview env.
critical_code_review_comments: conftest._sweep_polluted_artefacts uses synchronous pymongo against MONGO_URL but the rest of the codebase uses motor (async). This is FINE for a teardown fixture (separate connection, blocking is acceptable in test teardown) but ensure pymongo stays in requirements.txt — it currently is, so OK.

Pollution regex `^(iter|i)\s*23[01][a-z]{0,3}[-_ ]` would NOT match a hypothetical future 'iter232-foo' league. When iter232 work lands, broaden to `^(iter|i)\s*23\d[a-z]{0,3}[-_ ]` or include a trailing digit range. Not blocking; flag for next iter.

is_league_admin helper does NOT verify the user's existence/active status — only role checks. Callers must still ensure user is authenticated (which all 6 current callers do via get_current_user). Document this in the helper docstring (currently it says 'callers should have already verified' which is fine, but consider an assert/guard for defense in depth).

draft_restart_log collection has no TTL index — picks payloads can accumulate. Consider adding a TTL (e.g. 90 days) or capped collection for restart audit data. Same suggestion as iter231ab follow-up; this iter implemented the archive but not retention.

admin_managed endpoint at team_invites.py is a TEAM-level setting but lives in the invites router file — surprising from a discoverability standpoint. Consider moving to a teams_admin.py module or at minimum a header comment indicating why it's here (continuity with team_invites for Open Slot lifecycle).
